notes.raw: * ''Wither'' interrupts the target's [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack windup]] when it is first applied. (bug) * If ''Wither's'' duration is affected by [[File:Tenacity icon.png|20px|link=Tenacity|An icon representing the keyword Tenacity]] [[:Tenacity|Tenacity]] the effects will apply slower (negative tenacity percentage) or faster (positive tenacity percentage) so the maximum values are still reached when the modified duration ends. * ''Wither's'' cripple effectiveness calculates from its slow's base values, thus [[File:Slow immune icon.png|20px|link=Slow resist|An icon representing the keyword Slow resist]] [[:Slow resist|slow resist]] will not interact with the attack speed modifier indirectly. * Both [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] and [[File:Cripple icon.png|20px|link=Cripple|An icon representing the keyword Cripple]] [[:Cripple|cripple]] from ''Wither'' are considered to be a single [[File:Malefic Visions.png|20px|link=Debuff|An icon representing the keyword Debuff]] [[:Debuff|debuff]]. (unexpected) ** Therefore, [[File:Slow immune 2.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Slow-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|slow immunity]] will prevent both, even without technical [[File:Cripple immune.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Cripple Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cripple-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Cripple Immunity|cripple immunity]]. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Wither interrupts the target's attack windup when it is first applied. (bug)
If Wither's duration is affected by Tenacity the effects will apply slower (negative tenacity percentage) or faster (positive tenacity percentage) so the maximum values are still reached when the modified duration ends.
Wither's cripple effectiveness calculates from its slow's base values, thus slow resist will not interact with the attack speed modifier indirectly.
Both slow and cripple from Wither are considered to be a single debuff. (unexpected)
* Therefore, slow immunity will prevent both, even without technical cripple immunity.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
